```{r score post_scan_STAI_state_score}
# Code script to score the State-Trait Anxiety Inventory (State Only) - Spielberger et al. (1977)
# https://www.researchgate.net/publication/235361542_Manual_for_the_State-Trait_Anxiety_Inventory_Form_Y1_-_Y2
# Scoring instructions: Questions 1-20 refer to state anxiety. Higher scores indicate greater anxiety. Reverse code the items necessary, then calculate a sum of all individual item responses for state and trait scores and full STAI total.

# Load required packages
library(dplyr)
library (readr)

# Load data
post_scan_STAI <- read.csv("/Users/bsevchik/projects/EF_clinical/self-report/scale_csvs_Jan/ef_selfreport_post-scan_state.csv")

# Edit csv file
post_scan_STAI <- post_scan_STAI %>%
  select(-redcapid, -protocol, -protocol_number, -admin_timestamp, -date, -assessor, -location)
post_scan_STAI

# Compute total scores for each individual participant

rev_items <- c(
  "stai_q_01", "stai_q_02", "stai_q_05", "stai_q_08", "stai_q_10", "stai_q_11", "stai_q_15", "stai_q_16", "stai_q_19", "stai_q_20"
)

state_items <- c(
  "stai_q_01","stai_q_02","stai_q_03","stai_q_04","stai_q_05",
  "stai_q_06","stai_q_07","stai_q_08","stai_q_09","stai_q_10",
  "stai_q_11","stai_q_12","stai_q_13","stai_q_14","stai_q_15",
  "stai_q_16","stai_q_17","stai_q_18","stai_q_19","stai_q_20"
)

# Temp reverse-coded column names
tmp_rev <- paste0(rev_items, "_rc")

# Helper: swap reverse-keyed items for their _rc versions
score_cols <- function(items) {
  c(setdiff(items, rev_items), paste0(intersect(items, rev_items), "_rc"))
}

post_scan_STAI <- post_scan_STAI %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(state_items), as.numeric)) %>%
  # Create temp reverse-coded columns (preserve NA)
  mutate(across(all_of(rev_items), ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), NA_real_, 5 - .x), .names = "{.col}_rc")) %>%
  mutate(
    post_scan_STAI_state_total_score = rowSums(across(all_of(score_cols(state_items))), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  select(-all_of(tmp_rev))  # drop temp columns so item-level responses remain original

write_tsv(post_scan_STAI,"/Users/bsevchik/projects/EF_clinical/self-report/scale_csvs_Jan/final_scored_tsvs/post_scan_stai_state.tsv", na = "n/a")
```

``` {r post_scan_STAI distribution}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

post_scan_STAI %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = post_scan_STAI_state_total_score)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "STAI State total score (post-scan)", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of post-scan STAI State scores")

```
